note: All measurements are approximate and per standard teaspoons (5 ml) and tablespoons (15 ml). Adjust salt/chilli to taste.

steps.instruction: Soak cashews in hot water for 10 minutes. Blend tomatoes and soaked cashews to a smooth puree.
Heat butter and oil in a kadhai over medium heat. Add chopped onion and sauté until lightly golden (5–6 minutes).
Add ginger-garlic paste; sauté 1 minute until raw smell goes.
Pour in the tomato-cashew puree carefully (it may splutter). Cook, stirring, until thick, glossy, and oil separates (8–10 minutes).
Stir in chilli powder, turmeric, salt, and 150 ml water. Simmer 3 minutes.
Add paneer cubes, garam masala, kasuri methi, and sugar. Simmer gently 3–4 minutes.
Reduce heat and stir in cream. Add more water if needed to adjust gravy consistency. Cook 1 minute and switch off.
Rest 5 minutes; garnish with a knob of butter and a swirl of cream.
Drain soaked chickpeas. Pressure cook with 500 ml water and 0.5 tsp salt for 6–7 whistles (or 25 minutes in Instant Pot on high).
Heat oil in kadhai. Add bay leaf and cumin; let splutter 30 seconds.
Add onions; sauté until golden-brown (7–8 minutes).
Add ginger-garlic paste; sauté 1 minute. Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates (8–10 minutes).
Add coriander powder, chilli, turmeric, and garam masala. Cook 1 minute.
Add boiled chickpeas with 200 ml of their cooking liquid. Add remaining water as needed; simmer 10–12 minutes to thicken.
Stir in amchur or lemon juice, adjust salt. Garnish with coriander.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.split: 0.5 tsp for dough + 0.5 tsp for filling

steps.instruction: Make dough: Mix flour, 0.5 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp oil. Add water gradually and knead 8–10 minutes to a soft, smooth dough. Rest 15 minutes.
Prepare filling: In a bowl combine mashed potatoes, onion, green chilli, coriander leaves, remaining 0.5 tsp salt, cumin powder, amchur, and red chilli powder.
Divide dough into 8 balls (about 60 g each). Roll a ball to 12–13 cm circle, place 2–3 tbsp filling, gather edges and seal.
Roll the stuffed ball gently to 16–18 cm paratha using dry flour to dust.
Cook on a hot tawa: 30–40 sec first side, flip; apply ghee, cook 45–60 sec. Flip again, apply ghee, cook until golden spots appear.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.prep: as needed to grind and ferment

steps.instruction: Soak both rices together with poha and fenugreek for 4–6 hrs. Soak urad dal separately for 4–6 hrs.
Grind urad dal with some water to a fluffy batter. Grind rice mixture to a slightly coarse batter. Mix both, add 1 tsp salt, and ferment 8–12 hrs until doubled.

Prepare potato masala: Heat 1 tbsp oil, splutter mustard seeds, add urad dal, chana dal, curry leaves, slit chillies; sauté 1 min. Add onions; sauté till translucent. Add turmeric, potatoes, 0.75 tsp salt, lemon juice; mix. Add a splash of water if dry.
Make dosas: Heat tawa. Pour a ladle of batter and spread to thin circle. Drizzle oil/ghee; cook till crisp. Place potato masala and fold.
Heat ghee/oil. Add cumin, bay leaf, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon; sauté 30–40 seconds until aromatic.
Add onions; sauté until light golden (5 minutes). Add ginger-garlic paste; sauté 30 seconds.
Add mixed vegetables and green chilli; sauté 2 minutes.
Add drained rice and 2.5 cups water; add salt. Bring to boil, then cover and simmer on low 12–14 minutes until rice is cooked and water absorbed.
Rest covered 5 minutes; fluff with fork.
Pressure-cook dal with 500 ml water, turmeric, and 0.5 tsp salt for 4–5 whistles (Instant Pot 10 min high). Whisk to smooth.
Heat ghee for tadka. Add cumin, garlic, hing, and green chilli; sauté 1 minute. Add onion; sauté till light golden. Add tomato and chilli powder; cook 2 minutes.
Pour tadka into dal, add remaining salt, and simmer 3 minutes. Garnish with coriander.
Pressure-cook soaked rajma with 600 ml water and 0.5 tsp salt for 6–7 whistles (Instant Pot 30 min high).
Heat oil; add cumin. Add onions and sauté until golden-brown (8–10 minutes).
Add ginger-garlic paste; sauté 1 min. Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates (10 minutes).
Add coriander, chilli, turmeric, and garam masala; cook 1 minute.
Add boiled rajma with cooking liquid. Add extra water for desired consistency. Simmer 12–15 minutes.
Adjust salt; garnish with coriander.
Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes; drain and blend to a smooth puree.
Heat oil/ghee; add cumin. Add onion and sauté till translucent. Add ginger-garlic and green chilli; sauté 1 minute.
Add tomato (optional), turmeric, and salt; cook 2 minutes.
Add spinach puree; cook 3–4 minutes. Add paneer and garam masala; simmer 3 minutes.
Finish with cream (optional).
Heat oil; add cumin. Add onions and sauté until deep golden (10–12 minutes).
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes; cook until mushy and oil separates (6–8 minutes).
Add coriander, chilli, turmeric, and salt; cook 1 minute.
Add chicken pieces; sauté on high heat 3–4 minutes to seal.
Add water, cover, and simmer 18–20 minutes until chicken is tender.
Sprinkle garam masala and coriander; simmer 1 minute.

ingredients.name: whole spices (bay leaf, cardamom 4, cloves 4, cinnamon 1 inch)

steps.instruction: Cook rice 70%: Boil 2.5 cups salted water with whole spices. Add soaked rice; cook 6–7 minutes until just done. Drain.
Fry onions in 2 tbsp ghee until golden-brown; remove half for garnish.
To remaining onions add ginger-garlic, tomatoes, turmeric, biryani masala; cook 2–3 min. Add veggies, yogurt, mint, coriander, and 0.5 tsp salt; cook 5 minutes.
Layer: Half rice, then veg masala, then remaining rice. Top with fried onions, saffron milk, and 1 tbsp ghee.
Seal and cook on very low heat (dum) for 20 minutes. Rest 5 minutes before serving.
Rinse poha in a sieve under running water for 10–15 seconds; drain well. Sprinkle 2 tbsp water if very dry.
Heat oil; splutter mustard and cumin. Add peanuts; fry 1–2 minutes. Add onion and green chilli; sauté till translucent.
Add turmeric and salt. Add poha, sugar if using; mix gently and cook 2–3 minutes on low. Switch off; add lemon juice and coriander.
Dry roast semolina until aromatic; set aside.
Heat oil/ghee. Splutter mustard; add urad dal, chana dal, curry leaves, and chilli; sauté 1 minute. Add onion and veggies; sauté 2–3 minutes.
Add water and salt; bring to a rolling boil. Gradually add semolina, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Cook 2–3 minutes until thick.
Cover and rest 2 minutes; fluff and serve.
Heat oil; add cumin. Add potatoes and sauté 3 minutes.
Add cauliflower, turmeric, coriander powder, chilli powder, and salt; mix well.
Cover and cook on low, stirring occasionally, for 12–15 minutes until tender.
Sprinkle garam masala and coriander; toss and cook 1 minute.

ingredients.name: bhindi (okra)
ingredients.prep: washed, dried, cut into 3–4 cm pieces

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp oil; sauté bhindi on medium until non-sticky and lightly browned (8–10 minutes). Remove.
In same pan heat 1 tbsp oil; add cumin, onion and sauté 3–4 minutes. Add tomato, turmeric, coriander, chilli; cook 3 minutes.
Return bhindi; add amchur and salt; toss and cook 2 minutes.
Heat oil; sauté onion and curry leaves 3–4 minutes.
Add chilli, turmeric, coriander; cook 30 seconds. Add coconut milk, tamarind, and salt; bring to gentle simmer.
Add fish pieces; simmer on low 7–8 minutes until cooked through. Rest 2 minutes before serving.
Make syrup: Boil sugar and water for 5–6 minutes to a sticky (one-thread) consistency. Add cardamom and rose water; keep warm.
Make dough: Crumble khoya and paneer; mix with flour and baking powder. Add milk as needed to make a soft, crack-free dough.
Shape small smooth balls (about 15–18 pieces).
Fry on medium-low heat in ghee/oil, stirring gently, until deep golden (6–8 minutes).
Soak: Add fried jamuns to warm syrup; rest 1–2 hours before serving.

recipes.name: Congee (Rice Porridge)
instructions: Rinse rice and add to boiling water.
Simmer on low flame for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally until thick porridge forms.
Add salt and soy sauce.
Garnish with chopped spring onions and serve hot.
tips: Use short-grain rice for creamier texture.
Stir frequently to prevent sticking.

recipes.name: Miso Soup with Tofu
instructions: Boil water, add tofu and seaweed.
Turn off flame, dissolve miso paste in hot water and add to soup.
Garnish with green onions and serve.
tips: Do not boil miso paste to retain flavor and nutrients.
Use fresh tofu for best texture.

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl
ingredients: Sesame seeds and spring onions for garnish
instructions: Cut chicken into cubes and marinate with soy sauce, mirin, and sugar for 10 minutes.
Heat sesame oil, cook chicken until browned.
Serve over steamed rice, garnish with sesame seeds and spring onions.
tips: Simmer on low flame to thicken teriyaki sauce.
Use fresh chicken for tender meat.

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, sauté garlic.
Add vegetables, stir fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce, stir well.
Drizzle sesame oil and serve hot.
tips: Use leftover rice for best texture.
Keep vegetables slightly crunchy for taste.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry with Shrimp
instructions: Heat oil, sauté curry paste 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, stir and bring to boil.
Add vegetables, simmer 5 minutes.
Add shrimp, fish sauce, sugar, cook 5-7 minutes until shrimp are pink.
Garnish with basil leaves and serve hot.
tips: Do not overcook shrimp.
Adjust curry paste to taste.

recipes.name: Japanese Matcha Green Tea Ice Cream
instructions: Mix matcha powder with sugar.
Heat milk, add sugar-matcha mixture and dissolve.
Whisk cream and fold into milk mixture.
Churn in ice cream maker for 40 minutes or freeze for 2 hours.
Serve chilled.
tips: Sift matcha to avoid lumps.
Do not overwhip cream.

recipes.name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
instructions: Mix vegetables with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Place filling on wrapper, roll tightly, seal edges with water.
Heat oil, fry rolls until golden brown.
Serve hot with chili sauce.
tips: Do not overfill wrappers.
Serve immediately for best crunch.

recipes.name: Edamame Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Drizzle sesame oil and soy sauce, toss well.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve chilled.
tips: Use fresh edamame for better taste.
Chill salad before serving.

recipes.name: Bubble Tea (Taiwanese)
instructions: Cook tapioca pearls according to package instructions.
Brew tea leaves in hot water and mix with milk and sugar.
Add cooked tapioca pearls and ice cubes.
Serve cold with a wide straw.
tips: Use tapioca pearls immediately after cooking.
Adjust sugar to taste.

recipes.name: Korean Kimchi Pancakes
instructions: Mix kimchi, flour, water, and sesame oil into a batter.
Heat oil in pan, pour batter, spread evenly.
Cook until golden brown on both sides.
Serve hot.
tips: Do not make batter too thick.
Serve immediately for crisp texture.

recipes.name: Chana Chaat
instructions: Mix chickpeas, tomato, onion, and chili.
Add lemon juice and chaat masala.
Serve fresh.

recipes.name: Fruit Custard
ingredients: 1 cup mixed fruits (apple, banana, grapes, mango)
instructions: Boil milk and mix custard powder with sugar.
Cool and add chopped fruits.
Refrigerate before serving.

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
instructions: Make soft dough with khoya, flour, and baking powder.
Shape into balls.
Deep fry until golden.
Soak in sugar syrup.

recipes.name: Rasmalai
instructions: Boil milk with sugar and cardamom until thick.
Squeeze excess syrup from rasgullas.
Soak in thickened milk.
Garnish with pistachios and chill.

recipes.name: Rose Falooda
instructions: Mix milk with rose syrup.
Add soaked basil seeds and boiled vermicelli.
Top with ice cream and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Hara Bhara Kabab
instructions: Mash spinach, peas, and potatoes.
Mix with gram flour and spices.
Shape into patties and shallow fry.
Serve hot with chutney.

recipes.name: Chicken Pakora
instructions: Mix chicken with gram flour and spices.
Add water to make thick batter.
Deep fry until crispy.
Serve hot with chutney.

recipes.name: Samosa
instructions: Make dough with flour, oil, and water.
Cook filling with potatoes, peas, and spices.
Shape dough into cones, fill, and seal.
Deep fry until golden brown.

recipes.name: Aloo Tikki Chaat
instructions: Shape mashed potatoes with spices into tikkis.
Shallow fry until crisp.
Serve topped with yogurt, chutneys, and sev.

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka
instructions: Marinate paneer with yogurt, gram flour, spices, and lemon juice for 30 minutes.
Thread paneer on skewers.
Grill or bake until golden.
Serve hot with mint chutney.

recipes.name: Chicken Malai Tikka
instructions: Marinate chicken with cream, yogurt, spices, and lemon juice for 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill until tender and slightly charred.
Serve with green chutney.

recipes.name: Samosa
instructions: Make dough with flour, oil, and water.
Cook filling with potatoes, peas, and spices.
Shape dough into cones, fill, and seal.
Deep fry until golden brown.

recipes.name: Chicken Pakora
instructions: Mix chicken with gram flour and spices.
Add water to make thick batter.
Deep fry until crispy.
Serve hot with chutney.

recipes.name: Masala Chaas
instructions: Whisk buttermilk with cumin powder, black salt, and ginger.
Add coriander leaves.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Chicken Lassi
instructions: Blend yogurt with chicken, pepper, cumin, and salt.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Kachumber Salad
instructions: Mix cucumber, tomato, and onion.
Add lemon juice, black salt, and coriander.
Serve fresh.

recipes.name: Egg Salad with Curry Dressing
instructions: Mix yogurt with curry powder and salt.
Add chopped eggs, cucumber, and tomatoes.
Toss well and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
instructions: Make soft dough with khoya, flour, and baking powder.
Shape into balls.
Deep fry until golden.
Soak in sugar syrup.

recipes.name: Shahi Tukda
instructions: Boil milk with sugar, khoya, and cardamom to make rabri.
Fry bread slices until golden.
Pour rabri over fried bread.
Garnish with nuts and serve.

recipes.name: Iced Matcha Latte
instructions: Whisk matcha powder with hot water until smooth.
Add milk and honey.
Serve over ice cubes.

recipes.name: Masala Chai
instructions: Boil water with cardamom and ginger.
Add tea leaves and milk.
Simmer and strain.
Serve hot with sugar.

recipes.name: Thai Iced Tea
instructions: Brew tea in hot water.
Add condensed milk and sugar.
Serve chilled over ice.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Egg Coffee
instructions: Whisk egg yolk with sugar and condensed milk until frothy.
Pour hot coffee into a cup.
Top with egg foam and serve.

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
instructions: Blend mango pulp, yogurt, milk, and sugar.
Serve chilled with ice cubes.

recipes.name: Lychee Lemonade
instructions: Mix lychee juice, lime juice, and sugar.
Top with soda water.
Serve chilled over ice.

recipes.name: Green Tea Lemon Cooler
instructions: Brew green tea and cool it.
Mix with honey and lemon juice.
Serve over ice.

recipes.name: Rose Milk
instructions: Mix milk with rose syrup and sugar.
Serve chilled over ice.

recipes.name: Coconut Water Cooler
instructions: Mix coconut water, lime juice, and honey.
Serve chilled over ice.

recipes.name: Japanese Iced Coffee
instructions: Brew coffee with hot water.
Add sugar and stir.
Serve immediately over ice.

recipes.name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
instructions: Stir-fry vegetables with soy sauce.
Place filling in wrappers and roll tightly.
Deep fry until golden.
Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.name: Vegetable Hakka Noodles
instructions: Boil noodles and drain.
Stir-fry vegetables in oil.
Add sauces and noodles, toss well.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Chicken Satay
instructions: Marinate chicken with all ingredients for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry until cooked.
Serve with peanut sauce.

recipes.name: Vegetable Sushi Rolls
instructions: Spread rice on nori sheet.
Place cucumber, avocado, and carrot.
Roll tightly and slice.
Serve with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil, stir-fry vegetables.
Add rice and soy sauce.
Mix well and serve hot.

recipes.name: Korean Kimchi Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour, water, kimchi, and chili flakes.
Spread batter on pan with oil.
Cook until crispy both sides.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Japanese Miso Soup
instructions: Boil water and add miso paste.
Add tofu and seaweed.
Simmer 5 minutes and serve hot.

recipes.name: Sweet Mango Sticky Rice
instructions: Cook glutinous rice.
Heat coconut milk with sugar.
Mix rice with sweet coconut milk.
Serve with sliced mango.

recipes.name: Honey Chili Potatoes
instructions: Fry potato wedges until crispy.
Mix sauces and toss potatoes.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve.

recipes.name: Schezwan Paneer
instructions: Heat oil and stir-fry onions and capsicum.
Add paneer and schezwan sauce.
Cook 5 minutes and serve hot.

recipes.name: Sesame Peanut Brittle
instructions: Melt jaggery with ghee until caramelized.
Mix in sesame seeds and peanuts.
Spread on a greased plate and let it set.
Break into pieces and serve.

recipes.name: Paneer Pakora
instructions: Make batter with chickpea flour, spices, and water.
Dip paneer cubes in batter.
Deep fry until golden.
Serve with chutney.

recipes.name: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Cook minced chicken with soy sauce and ginger-garlic paste.
Add onions and bell peppers, sauté until tender.
Spoon mixture into lettuce leaves and serve.

recipes.name: Thai Glass Noodle Salad
instructions: Soak noodles in hot water until soft.
Mix fish sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes.
Toss noodles with shrimp and dressing.
Garnish with coriander.

recipes.name: Falooda
instructions: Soak basil seeds for 10 minutes.
Layer vermicelli, basil seeds, and rose syrup in a glass.
Pour chilled milk.
Top with ice cream and serve.

recipes.name: Egg Rolls
instructions: Cook eggs into thin omelettes.
Place omelette on paratha.
Add onions, peppers, and ketchup.
Roll tightly and serve.

recipes.name: Tom Yum Soup
instructions: Boil chicken broth with lemongrass, lime leaves, and chili paste.
Add shrimp and mushrooms.
Season with fish sauce.
Simmer 5 minutes and serve hot.

recipes.name: Coconut Jelly
instructions: Mix agar-agar with coconut milk and sugar.
Heat until dissolved.
Pour into molds and refrigerate until set.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Korean Cold Noodle Salad
instructions: Boil noodles and rinse under cold water.
Mix gochujang and rice vinegar for dressing.
Top noodles with cucumber, apple, and boiled egg.
Pour dressing and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Thai Lemon Grass Cooler
instructions: Boil water with lemongrass for 5 minutes.
Strain and cool.
Mix with honey and lime juice.
Serve over ice.

recipes.name: Coconut Ladoo
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan, add grated coconut.
Stir in condensed milk and cardamom powder.
Cook until mixture thickens.
Shape into small balls and serve.

recipes.name: Spring Rolls
instructions: Stir-fry vegetables with soy sauce for 2 minutes.
Place filling inside wrappers and roll tightly.
Deep fry until golden and crispy.
Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Gyoza
instructions: Mix ground chicken, cabbage, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Place filling inside wrappers and seal.
Pan fry for 2 minutes, then steam until cooked.
Serve with dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Korean Kimchi Salad
instructions: Mix kimchi with cucumber slices.
Drizzle with sesame oil.
Top with sesame seeds and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Taro Bubble Tea
instructions: Cook tapioca pearls until soft.
Blend taro with milk and sugar.
Pour into glass with ice and pearls.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Fish Cakes
instructions: Blend fish fillets, egg, breadcrumbs, and soy sauce into a paste.
Shape into small cakes.
Fry until golden brown.
Serve hot with chili sauce.

recipes.name: Miso Soup
instructions: Heat dashi broth and dissolve miso paste.
Add tofu and seaweed.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with spring onions.

recipes.name: Green Tea Matcha Cake
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, and matcha powder.
Beat eggs, sugar, and butter until fluffy.
Combine wet and dry ingredients.
Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Asian Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix fruits in a large bowl.
Drizzle with honey and lime juice.
Garnish with mint leaves.

recipes.name: Thai Iced Coffee
instructions: Brew strong coffee and let it cool.
Add condensed milk and evaporated milk.
Pour over ice and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
instructions: Soak sticky rice for 4 hours, then steam until cooked.
Heat coconut milk with sugar and salt until dissolved.
Mix half of the coconut milk with the rice.
Serve with mango slices, drizzle remaining coconut milk, sprinkle sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Sesame Honey Balls
instructions: Melt jaggery or honey until sticky.
Mix sesame seeds and peanuts.
Shape into small balls while warm.
Cool and store in airtight container.

recipes.name: Chicken Satay Skewers
instructions: Marinate chicken with soy sauce, peanut butter, lime juice, and chili paste for 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry until cooked through.
Serve with peanut dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Asian Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and sugar.
Toss cucumber slices with dressing.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Lychee Iced Tea
instructions: Brew black tea and let it cool.
Mix with lychee juice and sugar.
Serve over ice with fresh lychees.

recipes.name: Prawn Tempura
instructions: Mix tempura flour with cold water to make a light batter.
Dip prawns in batter.
Deep-fry until golden and crispy.
Serve with soy dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Steamed Veg Momos
instructions: Make dough with flour and water.
Mix cabbage, carrots, soy sauce, and ginger-garlic paste.
Fill dough circles with stuffing and shape dumplings.
Steam for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Thai Green Papaya Salad
ingredients: 1 tbsp fish sauce (or soy sauce for veg)
instructions: Mix lime juice, fish sauce/soy sauce, and chili flakes.
Toss papaya and carrot in dressing.
Top with crushed peanuts.

recipes.name: Matcha Mochi Ice Cream
instructions: Mix rice flour, sugar, water, and matcha powder.
Steam until doughy.
Roll dough into circles and wrap around ice cream scoops.
Freeze before serving.

recipes.name: Spiced Chai Latte
instructions: Boil milk with spices and ginger.
Add tea bags and steep for 5 minutes.
Strain, add sugar, and serve hot.

recipes.name: Vegetable Congee
instructions: Wash the rice and place it in a large pot.
Add 6 cups of vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 40–45 minutes until the rice breaks down and becomes porridge-like.
Add diced carrots, corn, and spinach, and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil.
Season with salt and garnish with spring onions.

recipes.name: Japanese Tamago Sushi
instructions: Beat eggs with sugar and soy sauce.
Cook in a non-stick pan to form a rectangular omelette.
Mix rice vinegar, sugar, and salt with warm sushi rice.
Cut omelette into strips and place over small rice balls.
Wrap with nori strip to secure.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
instructions: Heat a pan and cook the green curry paste until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add chicken and cook until no longer pink.
Add eggplant, bell pepper, kaffir lime leaves, fish sauce, and sugar.
Simmer until vegetables are tender.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve with steamed rice.

recipes.name: Vegetable Ramen Bowl
instructions: Bring vegetable broth to a boil and add miso paste and soy sauce.
Cook ramen noodles separately and add to the broth.
Add mushrooms and bok choy, cook for 3–4 minutes.
Top with a boiled egg (optional) and garnish with spring onions.

recipes.name: Korean Bibimbap
instructions: Sauté beef strips until cooked.
Blanch spinach and sauté carrot and zucchini separately.
Arrange rice in a bowl, place beef, vegetables, and fried egg on top.
Drizzle with sesame oil, sprinkle sesame seeds, and serve with gochujang.

recipes.name: Masala Chai (Indian Spiced Tea)
ingredients: 1 small piece of fresh ginger, sliced
instructions: In a saucepan, bring water to a boil with ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves.
Add tea leaves and simmer for 2–3 minutes.
Pour in milk and sugar, bring to a gentle boil and simmer for another 2 minutes.
Strain into cups and serve hot.

recipes.name: Coffee
instructions: In a saucepan, bring milk to a gentle boil with cinnamon, cardamom, and ginger.
Add instant coffee and sugar, stir well.
Simmer for 1–2 minutes.
Strain and serve hot.

recipes.name: Sweet Lassi
ingredients: Chopped pistachios or almonds for garnish (optional)
instructions: In a blender, combine yogurt, water (or milk), sugar, and cardamom powder.
Blend until smooth and frothy.
Pour into glasses, add ice cubes if desired.
Garnish with chopped nuts and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Chicken Seekh Kebabs
instructions: In a bowl, mix minced chicken with onions, chilies, spices, coriander, lemon juice, and bread crumbs.
Divide the mixture into equal portions and shape around skewers to form kebabs.
Preheat grill or oven to medium-high heat.
Place kebabs on grill/oven tray, brush with oil, and cook until golden brown and fully cooked (about 12–15 minutes), turning occasionally.
Serve hot with mint chutney or yogurt dip.

recipes.name: Classic Hummus
ingredients: Paprika & extra olive oil for garnish
instructions: In a food processor, blend chickpeas, tahini, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, and salt.
Gradually add cold water until smooth and creamy consistency is reached.
Transfer to a serving bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with paprika.
Serve with pita bread or fresh veggies.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma
ingredients: Sliced cucumber, tomato, and onion for filling
Tahini sauce or garlic sauce for serving
instructions: In a bowl, mix yogurt, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, and spices to make a marinade.
Coat chicken with marinade, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour (best overnight).
Grill or pan-cook chicken until fully cooked and slightly charred, then slice thinly.
Warm pita breads, fill with chicken, vegetables, and drizzle with tahini or garlic sauce.
Serve hot with extra sauce on the side.

recipes.name: Classic Beef Burger
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, onion, garlic, salt, pepper, and Worcestershire sauce.
Form into 4 patties.
Grill or pan-fry patties over medium-high heat for 4–5 minutes per side until cooked to desired doneness.
Lightly toast the burger buns.
Assemble burgers by placing lettuce, tomato, cheese, and patties inside buns.
Top with ketchup and mayonnaise, then serve hot.

recipes.name: Mac and Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package instructions and drain.
In a saucepan, melt butter and stir in flour to make a roux.
Gradually whisk in milk and cook until thickened.
Add cheese, salt, and pepper; stir until smooth.
Mix sauce with cooked macaroni and transfer to a baking dish (optional: top with bread crumbs).
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 15 minutes if desired crispy topping, otherwise serve directly.

recipes.name: BBQ Pork Ribs
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°C (320°F).
Remove the thin membrane from the back of the ribs.
Rub ribs with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Wrap ribs in foil and place on a baking tray.
Bake for 2–2.5 hours until tender.
Remove foil, brush with BBQ sauce, and bake or grill for another 10–15 minutes until glazed.
Serve hot with extra BBQ sauce.

recipes.name: Piri Piri Chicken
ingredients: 3–4 fresh red chilies (or 2 tbsp chili paste)
instructions: Blend chilies, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper into a marinade.
Rub marinade all over the chicken and let it rest for at least 1 hour (preferably overnight).
Preheat grill or oven to 200°C (400°F).
Grill or roast chicken for 40–45 minutes, basting occasionally, until fully cooked and slightly charred.
Serve hot with fries, salad, or bread.

recipes.name: Bunny Chow
ingredients: 500g chicken or lamb, cut into cubes
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until golden.
Add curry powder, turmeric, and cumin; cook for 1 minute.
Add meat and sear until browned.
Stir in tomatoes and cook until softened.
Add chicken stock and salt, simmer for 30 minutes until meat is tender.
Cut loaves of bread in half, hollow out the center, and fill with curry.
Garnish with coriander and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Jollof Rice
recipes.type: Vegetarian (or Non-Vegetarian if cooked with chicken stock)
instructions: Blend red bell peppers, tomatoes, onion, and garlic into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a pot, add tomato paste, and fry for 2 minutes.
Add the blended mixture and cook for 10 minutes until thickened.
Stir in thyme, curry powder, bay leaf, salt, and pepper.
Add rice and mix until coated with sauce.
Pour in stock, cover, and cook on low heat for 25–30 minutes until rice is fluffy.
Serve hot with fried plantains or grilled meat.

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C (430°F).
Roll out the pizza dough on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the dough.
Top with mozzarella slices and drizzle with olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is melted.
Garnish with fresh basil before serving.

recipes.name: Fish and Chips
instructions: Heat oil in a deep fryer or large pot to 180°C (350°F).
Rinse and dry potato fries, fry until golden and crispy, then drain.
In a bowl, mix flour, baking powder, salt, and cold sparkling water into a batter.
Dip fish fillets into batter, then fry until golden brown and cooked through (about 6–7 minutes).
Serve hot with fries, lemon wedges, and tartar sauce.

recipes.name: Greek Moussaka
instructions: Slice eggplants, sprinkle with salt, and let sit for 20 minutes. Pat dry and fry in olive oil until golden.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil, add ground meat, and cook until browned.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, wine, cinnamon, and oregano. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Prepare a béchamel sauce with butter, flour, and milk, then stir in parmesan.
In a baking dish, layer eggplant slices, meat sauce, and repeat. Top with béchamel sauce.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 40 minutes until golden on top.
Cool slightly before serving.
